import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/programs?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

data = res.read()

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"program\":{\"name\":\"Program A\",\"address_freeform\":\"500 Construction Way, Santa Barbara\",\"website\":\"http://www.example.com\",\"zip\":91013}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/programs", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"program":{"name":"Program A","address_freeform":"500 Construction Way, Santa Barbara","website":"http://www.example.com","zip":91013}}'
